app.name: Bug Hunt
title.lead: Learn QA Wrap in 5 quick levels.
title.sub: Find a bug on each page. Leave any time.
level.1.name: Wake it
level.2.name: Console clue
level.3.name: Dead button
level.4.name: Squeezed
level.5.name: The slow one
card.1.goal: Wake QA Wrap, then save the profile.
card.2.goal: Apply a coupon. Something will break.
card.3.goal: Press Next. Nothing happens? Write it down.
card.4.goal: Look at the order number. Does it fit?
card.5.goal: Press Pay, then stop, copy and paste.
card.1.look: Chrome may ask once. Press Allow.
card.2.look: Type any code, then press Apply.
card.3.look: Type it in the QA Wrap note box, then press Enter.
card.4.look: Use QA Wrap when the number looks wrong.
card.5.look: Pay is slow. That is the bug.
rail.goal.1: Wake QA Wrap, then press Save.
rail.goal.3: Press Next. Nothing happens? Note it.
rail.goal.4: Does the order number fit its box?
rail.goal.5: Press Pay, then stop and copy.
hint.1: Open QA Wrap, press its main button, then press Save here.
hint.2: Type any code in the coupon box, then press Apply.
hint.3: Press Next. If the page does not react, that is the bug.
hint.4: Look at the order number. Is any of it cut off?
hint.5: Press Pay and watch how long it takes.
nudge.generic: Take your time. Look at the page again.
qaw.label: QA Wrap state
bug.failed-request.name: Failed request
bug.failed-request.text: Save said Saved, but the request failed.
bug.console.name: Console error
bug.console.text: Apply threw an error, and the console recorded it.
bug.dead-button.name: Dead button
bug.dead-button.text: Next did nothing. A button that does nothing is a bug.
bug.layout.name: Layout bug
bug.layout.text: The order number does not fit its box.
bug.slow-call.name: Slow call
bug.slow-call.text: Pay took four seconds. Users give up sooner.
board.title: Tool score
clear.title: Level {n} clear
clear.tryLater: Not yet. Try this level later.
finale.title: Session complete
finale.pasteNote: This stays in this page and is not saved.
finale.found0: You found no bugs this time.
finale.send: This is what you send to a developer. It works on any site.
finale.ok: That is a real bug report.
finale.notYet: Not yet. Copy the report from QA Wrap, then paste.
finale.shareText: Bug Hunt: {stars} of 15 stars, score {score}, best time {time}.
set.title: Settings
pause.text: Paused. Press anywhere to go on.
err.wide: Use a wider window. Bug Hunt needs at least 1024 by 640.
err.engine: The game could not start. Run the game command again.
rail.stoppedNote: QA Wrap stopped. Start a new recording.
rail.nudgeAsleep: QA Wrap is asleep. Press its main button.
score.wrong.page-decoy: That part works as it should. Look for what is wrong.
score.wrong.note-early: Note a problem after you have seen it, not before.
score.wrong.note-duplicate: One note per problem is enough.
score.wrong.shot-early: Take the screenshot after you spot the problem.
score.wrong.shot-wrong-level: Save the screenshot for a layout problem.
score.wrong.stop-early: Press Stop after you have caught the bug.
score.wrong.copy-no-bug: A report with no problems has nothing to send. Catch a bug first.
score.wrong.generic: Use this tool at the right moment.

noise.expected: That failure is expected. Mark it Not a bug.
needs.catch: First catch the bug on the page.
needs.noise: Press Refresh offers, then mark the failure as Not a bug.
needs.feature: Now use the QA Wrap feature on the card.

trial.card.nohelp: No hints. No skip. Same pattern every time.

trial.attune.s4: Fire noise, then Not a bug
trial.attune.s5: Take a screenshot, then Add note and Enter

trial.attune.nokey: The shortcut did not work here. Allow starting without it.
trial.death.rest: Breathe. You can rest and come back.
